ink.role: Primary dark surface / body text on light

carousel_linkedin.note: LinkedIn document/carousel + feed image. Max 20 pages.

signature_moves: Concede the tool is genuinely good before naming the cost problem ('Photon is genuinely impressive engineering')
Nobody-did-anything-wrong framing — blame the absence of guardrails, never the engineer
One italicised aphorism per post ('The most expensive Databricks workload is often the one doing nothing.')
Named, specific numbers ($2.74M, 65-75%, >400% ROI) — never 'significant savings'
Close with BigHammer as the mechanism, not the hero: 'The discovery takes days. The savings start immediately.'
voice.author: Srinath Reddy, Founder & CEO, BigHammer.ai
